title: No project publishes a status file yet
foundBy: session agent, while building this repository

evidence.verified: Each of the nine projects in projects.json serves ci-status.json in schema 2, and scripts/check-status.py accepts all nine. Every sibling's pages workflow runs this repository's action.

resolution: Every listed project publishes its status file from its own pages workflow, with the action this repository carries.
details: The CI page assembles codesweep.ai/<project>/ci-status.json from every project listed in projects.json. None of them publishes one, so the page renders seven unreachable cards. Six of the seven serve Pages straight from their main branch. Publishing a file there would mean committing it on every build. They move to workflow-built Pages first, so the status ships in the deployment instead. The worked example is examples/lint-pages.yml. The ui project is already workflow-built and needs the other variant, which dispatches its pages workflow. That is because a push made with GITHUB_TOKEN starts no workflow.

notes.text: Every project listed in projects.json now publishes a status file. Fetched https://codesweep.ai/<project>/ci-status.json for campaign, ledger, lint, sandbox, tracer, ui and vcr on 2026-09-10. All seven returned HTTP 200, each schema 1 and generated that day. scripts/check-status.py accepted every one against SPEC.md. The record stays open because a closure has to cite a commit in this repository, and the work landed in the seven project repositories instead.
